name: gh-project-cost
title_zh: 文档没写成本就老实写「未记录」的尽调成本栏
tagline_zh: 接手陌生开源项目时，最怕把 README 里的定价当事实写进报告。
tagline_en: Fills the COST rows of a non-technical GitHub onboarding report — user pricing, running cost, funding, documented.
desc_en: Writes the COST rows of a non-technical GitHub onboarding report: price for users, running/infrastructure cost, funding and sponsors, documented development effort — strictly from what the documentation says (facts.cost via the GitHub MCP); writes 'Not documented' otherwise. Used by /onboard-project.
why_zh: 它把「查不到」当成合法结论输出，而不是留空或编一个合理数字。成本类字段最容易脑补，它偏不脑补。
why_en: It treats 'not found' as a valid result rather than a blank or a plausible guess, so every cost figure in the report traces back.
limit_zh: 只写 COST 这一栏，技术栈、活跃度、许可证都不管；必须跑在 /onboard-project 流程里。
limit_en: Only the COST rows — no stack, activity, or license. Needs the /onboard-project flow plus GitHub MCP for facts.cost. Unstated pricing, sponsors, or.
title_en: Cost rows for GitHub onboarding reports, sourced or marked.
